name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The project has completed a Definitive Feasibility Study (June 2026) with Proven and Probable Reserves of 184 Moz silver and 1.8 Moz gold. The company is in the development stage, targeting early works in Q3 2026 and a Final Investment Decision in Q2 2027, with first production expected by end of 2029.
